$comment: Copy this file to range/images.json and edit it. Nothing here points at a CyberPatriot download:
the competition images are distributed to coaches through the CyberPatriot portal, not public URLs.
Put the ZIP/OVA you downloaded on this computer (source.kind = local) or on your own server
(source.kind = url). Pull checks the SHA-256 when you give one, then boots a throw-away copy.
Prepare each image ONCE as a template: install your SSH key (Linux/FreeBSD) or enable WinRM
(Windows), then shut it down. The range never modifies the base disk.

images.name: Linux Mint 21 (practice)
images.notes: Template: added ~/.ssh/authorized_keys for the range key and enabled openssh-server.

images.name: Debian 12 (practice)
images.notes: A plain qcow2 on the coach's file server. Fill in sha256 so a damaged download cannot boot.

images.name: Windows 11 (practice)
images.notes: Template: WinRM over HTTP enabled for the range host's subnet, Administrator password set and stored in RAMPART_WIN_PASSWORD.

images.name: Windows Server 2022 (VM I started myself)
images.notes: provider attach: the agent does not boot anything, it connects to the VM you already started in VirtualBox/VMware.
